title: BAI Announces Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course is vital for developing high-level badminton coaches within India, directly impacting future player performance and talent pipelines.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course to be held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14 to 23, 2026.

title: New Regulations Issued for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations govern a key domestic tournament, shaping competition for Indian state teams and identifying national talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and formats for the national event.

title: Women’s Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: This update directly affects the composition of India's junior national team vying for spots at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: An important notification has been issued regarding a change in the Women's Doubles pair participating in the selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Junior National Team Camp Kicks Off in Guwahati
indian_angle: This coaching camp is crucial for preparing India's promising U17 and U15 junior players for the upcoming Badminton Asia Junior Championships.
summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is hosting the Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026, focusing on player development and strategy.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Events
indian_angle: This significant rule change for domestic junior tournaments will impact game strategy and player development across India's U13, U15, and U17 categories.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
